release_notes: Build 115 makes SQLite the recovery source for quiz project data, storing the exact quiz manifest and compressed non-video project source files for protected Quiz History entries.
New quiz projects are protected automatically in the background, and older existing projects can be backfilled from Settings → Project Integrity with Protect existing quizzes.

Restore missing quiz files recreates missing cards, audio, manifests, metadata and timeline files from SQLite without overwriting files that still exist; final videos remain derived outputs that can be rendered again.

The FactVault SQLite database is backed up automatically once per day to Z:\Factburst Quiz Manager\Database Backups when Z: is available, with a Back up database now button for immediate verified backups.
Database backups use SQLite's live backup API and must pass PRAGMA integrity_check before the backup is kept.
Build 114 Website Sync archive recovery remains included unchanged.
